podcast.title: Formation of Independent Label
podcast.body: After the president of Mercury Records expressed that Roy Hammond was "holding himself back" by recording political songs, Hammond decided to form his own record label. This enabled him to release politically charged music, such as "Impeached the President," without label interference. "So Roy Hammond formed his own record label For impeached the president which is listed as being by the honeydrippers"

podcast.title: Sampling of "Impeached the President"
podcast.body: "Impeached the President" is one of the most sampled songs in music history. Roy Hammond was aware that other artists were "borrowing parts of his song" for years, but he only confirmed it when he heard Janet Jackson's "That's The Way Love Goes." Despite its widespread sampling, Hammond received no financial compensation until the song was re-released on iTunes in 2017, largely due to its frequent unauthorized use. Hammond passed away in 2020. "The other notable thing about this song is that it is one of the most sampled songs ever Roy had been told for years that other artists were borrowing parts of his song But he did not know for sure until he heard that's the way love goes by Janet Jackson He got no money from that If he had he would have raked in a lot of cash The song was re-released on iTunes in 2017 Largely because it was being sampled so often with no financial compensation to Roy who died in 2020"
